GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.title: Gu Hand
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.descriptio: Displays Gu Worms with activations remaining as an extra hand. Play Activate before choosing a Gu card; canceling target selection keeps activation mode active.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.title: Gu Recovery Pile
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.descript: Stores depleted Gu Worms. Each Gu Worm has an independent recovery time based on type and rank; some rank-3 or higher Gu create normal derivative cards during recovery. Left-click to inspect; right-click and spend 1 Energy to deduce a Killer Move. Materials are selected from currently available Gu in the Gu Hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.empty: The Gu Recovery Pile is empty.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.selectionP: Choose the next Gu Worm in recipe order. {SelectedCount} selected; after choosing at least one, confirm or go back to finish.
